PANCHAYATS, RURAL HOUSING AND RURAL DEVELOPMENT DEPARTMENT 
NOTIFICATION 
Sachivalaya, Gandhinagar, 30th June, 2025 
GUJARAT PANCHAYATS ACT, 1993. 
No. KP/29 of 2025/PRHRDD/KRT/e-file/14/2025/1242/KH:- In exercise of the powers conferred by sub-section (5) 
of section 227 read with section 274 of the Gujarat Panchayats Act, 1993 (Guj. 18 of 1993), the Government of Gujarat 
hereby makes the following rules, further to amend the Extension Officer, Class III (Panchayat)/Taluka Panchayat 
Officer/ Extension Officer (Agriculture)/Extension Officer (Co-operation), Departmental Examination Rules, 2009, 
namely:- 
1. 
(1)  
These rules may be called the Extension Officer, Class III (Panchayat)/Taluka Panchayat Officer/ Extension 
Officer (Agriculture)/Extension Officer (Co-operation), Departmental Examination (Amendment) Rules, 
2025.     
           (2)  
They shall come into force on the date of their publication in Official Gazette. 
2. 
In the Extension Officer, Class III (Panchayat)/ Taluka Panchayat Officer / Extension Officer (Agriculture)/ 
Extension Officer(Co-operation), Departmental Examination Rules, 2009 (hereinafter referred to as “the said 
rules”), in rule 1, in sub-rule (1), after the words and brackets “Extension Officer (Co-operation)”, the words and 
brackets “(Panchayat Service) Lower Level” shall be inserted.
